ja.title: 24時間と48時間の測定から72時間後のTCE薬効を予測できるか
ja.summary: 5T4×CD3の公開実験を再解析。24・48時間の観測平均だけから72時間を予測し、単純な外挿との違いと測定を省略できない条件を調べる。
ja.seo_title: TCEの早期測定から72時間後の薬効を予測する
ja.seo_description: 5T4×CD3 TCEの24・48時間の実験値から72時間を予測。時間依存モデル、持越し、直線外挿を比較し、遅れの識別と測定時間の選択を検討する。

en.title: Can 24- and 48-hour measurements predict a 72-hour TCE assay response?
en.summary: A 5T4×CD3 time-course reanalysis fits 24- and 48-hour means and predicts 72 hours, testing lag selection, simple references and digitization sensitivity.
en.seo_title: Can early TCE assays predict 72-hour activity?
en.seo_description: 5T4×CD3 assay means test 72-hour predictions from early measurements. Cell-line differences and weak lag identification limit evidence for omitting late assays.

english.title: Can 24- and 48-hour measurements predict a 72-hour TCE assay response?
english.summary: Retrospective time-extrapolation benchmark using 54 aggregate means in two 5T4/CD3 cell-line assays. Early-only estimation and lag selection are compared with carry-forward and linear baselines. Lag sensitivity, reading uncertainty and unavailable donor linkage constrain measurement-shortening claims.
